podcast.body: An early live recording of this song was made at the BBC, predating its official studio recording and release as the band's first single. "That was recorded live at the BBC long before it was properly recorded and released as the band's first single."

podcast.body: This song is identified as Siouxsie and the Banshees' very first single and is considered "the very first post punk single," appearing in a British magazine called Sounds in 1977. While not punk rock, its existence was contingent on punk having come first. "It's Susie in the Banshees with Hong Kong Garden."
